title: AI Generate Failure Table
description: Synthesizes diagnostic arrays from hw_analyzer, pod-analyzer, and app_analyzer to categorize disruptions and output a Master Failure Table.
prompt:
Cross-reference the provided inputs using the `failure-tables.md` logic blocks. Categorize each disruption strictly into one of the 7 `Case` values defined in `concepts/failure-tables.md` (`Monitor for Potential HW Issue`, `Recommend Node Replacement`, `Expected HW Interruption - No Action`, `Expected HW Interruption - Detected repeated bad machine`, `Elastic Upshard`, `Manual Intervention`, or `Unknown Case`). Format as a GitHub-flavored markdown failure table with `Restart Attempt` (e.g., Attempt 0 for initial/absorbed, Attempt 1, Attempt 2, etc.) as the first column (or `Run` in per-run forensics mode, see `playbooks/run-forensics-report-template.md`), followed by Timestamp (UTC), Culprit Pod & Host, Root Signature / Mechanism, Downstream Impact & Failure Mode, Case, and Recovery Outcome. Primary metadata header or explicit column must include: Machine Type / Infra Spec: ${infra_specs}. Parameters -> Workload: ${workload_name}, Machine Type / Infra Spec: ${infra_specs}, Hardware Analysis: ${hw_analysis}, Pod Analysis: ${pod_analysis}, App Analysis: ${app_analysis}.
Note: If a file path (e.g. `_file`) is provided for inputs like timeline or crash_signatures (e.g. `scratch/*.json`), read directly from the scratch file on disk to avoid context window blowup, rather than expecting a large inline JSON string.
When synthesizing the root cause and executive summary across multi-attempt or multi-run timelines, compute inter-attempt time deltas from the timeline input, highlight large scheduling/timeline gaps (>1000s / >1100s), quote the earliest primary failure per attempt or run, and distinguish repeat-offender hardware (2+ primary incidents on the same instance or node pool) from single-incident or manual interventions.

infra_specs.description: Resolved infrastructure specifications including machine_type and accelerator_type

hw_analysis.description: Diagnostic array from hardware/VM intervention logs

pod_analysis.description: Diagnostic array covering Stage1a and Stage2a scheduling/mount delays

app_analysis.description: Diagnostic array capturing fatal application traces (DATA_LOSS, CUDA error, etc.)
